notes.title: Gamescom 2025 Participants: Conclusion
notes.notes: [p]We were there for full 4 days; the vibe at the Indie Arena was super cool, though standing for 10 hours a day was kinda rough. But we got really lucky with our booth neighbors – we had each other’s backs, covered shifts, and just helped out overall.[/p][p]We didn’t really get a chance to explore much outside the Indie Arena, but honestly there was sooo much going on that I didn’t even manage to play all the indies there![/p][p][/p][p]People were playing The August Before [b]NON-STOP[/b]. Like, the first person showed up at 9:30 AM and after that we never had a break longer than 2 minutes. Our business cards ran out halfway through the first day, so we had to reprint twice, and then we just started writing the game’s name on sticky notes and handing those out, ‘cause printing more again was just [b]too[/b] expensive ːsteamfacepalmː[/p][p][/p][p]Oh and btw [b]WE WON A WINGS AWARD[/b]???? [i](we didn't know it coming like .. AT ALL)[/i]. So we would like to give additional thanks to Indie Arena Booth & WINGS for this.[/p][p][/p][p]All in all, Gamescom went amazing! Thank you all for coming, playing and saying all this kind words![/p][p]Now back to work[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831427/48d235953bf4f4658c837868c3f31c960ed2ae6d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The August Before: Chapter One is available now for free!
notes.notes:
[h1]The August Before: Chapter One is out now![/h1]

You can now play The August Before: Chapter One for free! We're really looking forward to your feedback and hope you enjoy the first chapter in August's story. You can [b]leave a review[/b] to give your feedback and help us as we continue developing the full game. 

[b]Play The August Before: Chapter One for free now from the widget below![/b]

steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2516940/The_August_Before_Chapter_One/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget

Please don't forget to [b]wishlist The August Before[/b] if you enjoy the prologue version! Wishlists are much appreciated as they help us show our game to more people and let us know you're interested in our game.


[h2]What was added to The August Before: Chapter One?[/h2]

Since our previous publically available version, we've made a lot of improvements and additions to the game. You can find a list of these changes below.


[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added transition to the new room
[*] You can now carry multiple objects at once
[*] You can't take it all with you — now your goal is not only to pack everything in your suitcase; you will have to choose what to take
[*] You don't need to zoom items in or out to put them in place
[*] Excessive UI-elements removed
[/list]

[h3]UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] 3 more crosshair options
[*] New menu interactions
[*] New tutorial steps
[*] new VFX
[*] Mouse sensitivity settings added
[*] Animations for all items
[*] Hints-mode is available
[/list]

[h3]Visual[/h3]
[list]
[*] New textures (photos, books, magazines)
[*] New objects
[*] Second room preview
[*] New character-related objects
[*] Reworked existing objects and minor adjustments to textures, colors, and other details
[/list]

[h3]SFX[/h3]
[list]
[*] New in-game music
[*] New sound effects
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Objects do not overlap with each other
[*] Objects do not fall through surfaces
[*] Objects are not clipping
[*] Light and shadows are not flickering when set on low graphics mode
[*] Photo album bugs fixed
[*] All objects on the pin board can be examined
[*] Other small bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Introduction + bugs&errors reports
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone! SillyLittleGames speaking:) We are grateful that we have so many new players in the last few days, so we decided to give you heads up on who we are

allow to introduce ourselves —we are a SillyLittleGames studio !!

1️⃣  We are based in Serbia;

2️⃣  We are silly and little (not in a "minor" way, okay?);

3️⃣  We are making games. 

You can read more about us [url=https://the-august-before.tilda.ws/]on our website[/url]: you can also find all of our social networks there

Please, if you stumble on any bugs, errors, or unpleasant moments, PLEASE PLEASE report them in the community hub, or in the specified channel [url=https://discord.gg/AYKSYhra]on our Discord server[/url]. We are only 3 people, therefore, we clearly lack any QA resources, and it would be very helpful. The game has a lot of things to work on, and we are currently focusing on polishing it.
